//: Accounts whose NEW posts should be auto-liked by your logged-in session.
//username: Use the exact Instagram handle WITHOUT the @, e.g. for instagram.com/deltafitgta the username is 'deltafitgta'.
//checkLatestPosts: How many of the most recent grid posts to inspect each run. New posts beyond this in a single run would be missed, so keep your schedule frequent enough.
//headless: true = no visible window (good for servers/cron). false = watch it work.
//dryRun: true = find posts and report what WOULD be liked, but never click Like. Override per-run with --dry-run.
//humanDelayMs: Random pause range (ms) between actions to look less robotic and stay gentle on the account.
